sections.title: The letter en
paragraphs: The name of the letter is (эн) /ɛn/. Its main sound is in (нос) /nos/, which means nose. The letter makes two sounds in Russian.

sections.title: Pronouncing the letter
paragraphs: For the first sound, press the tongue tip against the back of the upper teeth. Let air flow out through your nose. For the second sound, raise the middle of the tongue toward the roof of the mouth. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake on both sounds.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: Before hard vowels and other consonants, or at the end of a word, it sounds hard. You hear this sound in (сон) /son/. Before soft vowels and the soft sign, it sounds palatalized. Palatalized means you raise the middle of your tongue toward the roof of the mouth. You hear this soft sound in (нет) /nʲet/ and (день) /dʲenʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not place your tongue behind your upper teeth as in the English word no. Put your tongue tip directly on the back of your teeth instead. For the soft sound, do not add an extra y sound as in canyon. Keep your tongue high against the roof of the mouth while the sound flows smoothly.
